propositions: Add a CLI flag `rebar review-plan --retry` that resumes only the literal latest eligible review with a fresh per-invocation attempt budget, refusing before any model call if the latest result is not indeterminate, missing a versioned discovery_journal, stale, corrupt, legacy, or digest-mismatched.

Retry eligibility is determined by reading the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar and its embedded discovery_journal: reusable units are those with journal kind success or resumed; missing units are those with kind failed, cancelled, or budget_indeterminate; the verdict must be indeterminate with at least one retryable unit.

For each reusable unit, recompute its checkpoint_identity from current ticket material, code/ref, effective policy, prompts/contracts, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and source; load the envelope via sizing.load_checkpoint and reuse its findings; units whose digest matches no stored envelope or whose envelope is absent are treated as missing and re-run.

Retry calls only missing units with the fresh attempt budget, reuses all eligible checkpoint findings (clean and blocking results), runs pass-2 verification and coaching only for newly recovered findings, and reruns deterministic decision, assembly, signature eligibility, and response rendering over the combined result.

The `--retry` flag is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`, remains compatible with `--no-sign`, and exits with code 2 (indeterminate/non-runnable) on refusal; normal review behavior is unchanged without the flag.

Document the retry flag in review-plan --help, docs/cli-reference.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, and docs/exit-codes.md, explaining eligibility, fresh budget, reuse semantics, zero-call refusal, flag interactions, signing, and the normal full-review remedy.
